# Each manifest entry the vendored libraries declare, reviewed. vendor.py
# fails on any other. "add": omni's builder declares it (manifest-fragment.xml);
# "omit": not declared, so nothing can start it.
#
# Play services' version check, which basement reads.
add meta-data com.google.android.gms.version
# Play's fix-it dialogs (exported="false"); the bridge never asks for one.
omit activity com.google.android.play.core.common.PlayCoreDialogWrapperActivity
